content:
See the list of Finalists!

The BIM Excellence Award aims to value and promote digitalisation and the implementation of the BIM methodology at national level, through the dissemination and promotion of good practices, especially those based on existing standards and reference frameworks, strengthening the sector's competitiveness internationally.

It therefore aims to encourage the structuring of information on the sector's products, promote the adoption of BIM and the digitalisation of processes throughout the whole life cycle of assets, as well as the use of BIM and digital construction in the public and private sectors, through the dissemination of success stories and the demonstration of their benefits, as well as fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing and the creation of synergies between entities in the sector.

In the 2026 edition, the BIM Excellence Award continues its mission, reflecting the evolution of the sector's digital maturity and placing renewed emphasis on interoperability, structured information management and technological innovation associated with the BIM methodology.

The BIM Excellence Award was created by CT197-BIM, the National BIM Standardisation Technical Committee, made up of dozens of voluntary experts who contribute to BIM standardisation. In the latest edition, BUILT CoLAB, the AEC Cluster and PTPC – the Portuguese Construction Technology Platform, have joined this initiative, with the aim of promoting good practices and raising awareness among industry and public administration of the need for digital transition in construction.

Finalists

After the jury analysed the 30 applications received, the following finalists were selected:

Category – Clients: Procurement and Management

  • Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (PGDL – Lisbon General Drainage Plan)
  • Lisboa Ocidental SRU (Implementation of the BIM Methodology at the company)
  • Fidelidade Property Europe + Limsen Consulting (Fidelidade Headquarters in Lisbon – Entrecampos Integrated Operation)

Category – Coordination and Design

  • COBA – Consultores de Engenharia e Ambiente (Extension of the yellow and green lines: Rato – Cais do Sodré | Design and construction contract for the shell works)
  • Prospectiva – Projectos, Serviços, Estudos (Start Campus Sines 4.0 – Masterplan for the 1.2 GW Campus)
  • Mota-Engil Global (Hospital Lisboa Oriental)

Category – Planning and Construction

  • ACA – Alberto Couto Alves (Troia Resort – UNOP 3, Plot 2)
  • HCI Construções + Limsen Consulting (New Headquarters of Caixa Geral de Depósitos in Lisbon)
  • T.L. – Sociedade de Construções (Botânica Building in Vilamoura)

Category – Built Environment Management

  • Quadrante – Engenharia e Consultoria (BIMconnect – openBIM Platform for Digital Built Environment Management)
  • Castro Red Build (PLINTO – Technical and Operational Interoperability Platform)
  • TPF – Consultores de Engenharia e Arquitetura (PGI – Information Management Platform – Innovation Centre)

Category – Technological innovation in BIM

  • TwinStudio, Unipessoal (GoTwin)
  • Mota-Engil Global (Site Management Control Platform: Mota-Engil BIM Viewer)
  • Ventura & Partners – Arquitetos (ArchAI – Intelligent Automation in BIM Workflows – Execution Project for Companhia Aurifícia)

The Interoperability: openBIM category has no finalists.

The winners will be announced at the awards ceremony, to be held in the late afternoon of 17 November 2026, as part of openBIM DAY'26, at LNEC, in Lisbon.

Organisation and Support

This award is an initiative of CT197-BIM, with the support of BUILT CoLAB, the AEC Cluster and PTPC. These entities share the cross-cutting mission of promoting good practices in the construction industry, highlighting the importance of innovation and digitalisation of the industry and the built environment, promoting the digital and sustainable transition of buildings and infrastructure, making them adaptable, intelligent, resilient and sustainable.

Regulations

Categories you can apply for

The BIM Excellence Award 2026 will distinguish six categories:
1. Clients: Procurement and Management;
2. Coordination and Design;
3. Planning and Construction;
4. Built Environment Management;
5. Interoperability: openBIM;
6. Technological Innovation in BIM.

General Eligibility Criteria

The BIM Excellence Award 2026 is open to entities based in national territory, including companies, public entities, academic institutions or consortia, that demonstrate relevant experience in implementing the BIM methodology.

For eligibility purposes, the following conditions apply:
• Projects submitted may be ongoing or may have been completed between the start of 2024 and the end of 2025;
• Projects that have won in previous editions in the same category are not eligible;
• Candidates may submit projects developed in national or international territory, provided they demonstrate a relevant role in their implementation.

See all the eligibility criteria for each category in more detail by consulting the full Regulations here.

Important Dates
  • Application submission period: 15 April to 31 May 12 June (at 11:59 pm) 2026
  • Announcement of finalists: 31 July 2026
  • Submission period for presentation videos: 1 to 30 September 2026
  • Awards ceremony: November 2026 (date and venue to be defined).
Jury

The Jury for the BIM Excellence Award 2026 is made up of experts of recognised merit at national and international level, including representatives of the organising entities and academic and professional institutions in the sector.

Organising committee:
• Chair of CT 197 – BIM / Laboratório Nacional de Engenharia Civil: Paula Couto (Chair of the Jury);
• Sectoral Standardisation Body (ONS) of CT 197 – BIM / BUILT CoLAB: Débora Pinto;
• AEC Cluster / Portuguese Construction Technology Platform: Rita Moura.
Institutional and professional entities:
• Ordem dos Engenheiros: Fernando Pinho;
• Ordem dos Arquitetos: Cláudia Antunes;
• buildingSMART Portugal: José Carlos Lino.
National academic institutions:
• Universidade de Lisboa – Instituto Superior Técnico – CERIS: António Aguiar Costa;
• Universidade de Lisboa – Instituto Superior Técnico – CiTUA: Francisco Teixeira Bastos;
• Universidade do Porto – Faculdade de Engenharia – CONSTRUCT: João Poças Martins;
• Universidade do Minho – Escola de Engenharia – ISISE: Miguel Azenha;
• Instituto Politécnico do Porto – Instituto Superior de Engenharia do Porto – iBuilt: Diogo Ribeiro.
Invited international members:
• Universidade de São Paulo: Eduardo Toledo Santos;
• University of Bath: Ricardo Codinhoto;
• buildingSMART Spain: Sergio Muñoz Gómez.

The Chair of the Jury will have the casting vote in the event of a tie.

Assessment Stages

The selection process includes the following stages:
i) Application submission stage; 
ii) Validation of entries: verification of the formal compliance of the applications submitted;
iii) Technical assessment of applications and selection of finalists;
iv) Communication to finalists: candidates selected as finalists will be formally notified and must submit a presentation video of the project, lasting no more than 5 minutes. The video must highlight the main aspects of the application, and may also answer specific questions identified by the Jury;
v) Final assessment and selection of winners and any honourable mentions;
vi) Awards ceremony: finalists must attend the official awards ceremony, in person, during which a brief public presentation of the finalist projects will be made, in a format and duration to be communicated in due course by the organisation;
vii) Public announcement of winners.

See all the Assessment Stages in more detail by consulting the full Regulations here.

Conditions for Submitting an Application

• Candidates may submit the same project in different categories, provided they present independent applications specifically adapted to the category they are applying for. Submitting identical or substantially equivalent content between applications is not permitted; each submission must demonstrate an approach, framing and results aligned with the respective category;
• Whenever there is a potential conflict of interest between a candidate and a member of the Jury, that member will be excluded from assessing the application in question;
• Applications must be submitted exclusively via the CT197 website: www.ct197.pt;
• The application form must be completed in full.

Participation in the BIM Excellence Award implies full acceptance of the regulations and requires that:
• Candidates authorise the use and disclosure of the submitted information for the purposes of the Award's institutional communication;
• Candidates guarantee they hold the rights necessary to disclose the projects presented;
• Candidates accept the decisions of the Jury, which are final and not subject to appeal.

Award

Finalists and winners will be entitled to:
• Physical trophy (winners);
• Digital seal (winners and honourable mentions);
• Official BIM Excellence Award certificate;
• Institutional and media coverage of the applications and projects.

Contacts

If you have any further questions, please contact the organisation by e-mail at bimct197@gmail.com.

Full Regulations

The Regulations for the BIM Excellence Award 2026 are available for consultation here.
